title: Create src/commands/status.ts — register Commander subcommand
description: Register the 'rocket status' subcommand in Commander with all four flags: --watch, --json, --category, --incomplete. Wire to StatusDashboard Ink component or JSON output.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket status --help shows all four flags
Command resolves without errors when .agent/tasks.json is present

steps.details: Create stub: export async function statusCommand(options: { watch?: boolean; json?: boolean; category?: string; incomplete?: boolean }): Promise<void> { console.log('status', options) }

In src/cli.ts: program.command('status').description('Show project progress dashboard').option('--watch', 'Auto-refresh every 5 seconds').option('--json', 'Output JSON instead of TUI').option('--category <name>', 'Filter to a specific category').option('--incomplete', 'List all incomplete tasks').action(statusCommand)
Run `npm run dev -- status --help` and confirm all four flags appear.
